The '''Lumbridge pond''' is a small body of water found amongst the farms of [[Lumbridge]] and [[Draynor]]. The pond features two [[duck]]s and two [[duckling]]s, all of whom are attackable, as well as two more ducks outside of the pond that can only be [[examined]].
